footer.intro: Records, profiles and fights of the greatest boxers in the world. Data aggregated from multiple sources and cached.
footer.disclaimer: Demo — records shown without an API key are approximate. Records of known boxers: Wikipedia (CC BY-SA). Built with Next.js · React · Tailwind · Framer Motion.

home.heroBadge: The world of boxing at a glance

home.sourceBigballsDesc: 12,000+ boxer profiles with complete technical sheets.
home.sourceThesportsdbDesc: Free community database: boxers, events and visuals.
home.sourceOddsDesc: Upcoming fights and odds, refreshed every 10 minutes.
